Status is the judgment call: the operating company is insolvent/in liquidation, the brand lives on in the founders' new company (imprint https://www.horizn-studios.com/pages/imprint); if the pipeline needs a stated asset sale, fall back to defunct.

adglow.status_detail: Adglow Corp SL (Madrid, CIF B87330684), the merged holding, filed for voluntary insolvency: court order of 19 Jan 2026 (Madrid commercial court, case 1019/2025) declared the concurso, opened liquidation, dissolved the company and removed the directors (BORME, registered 4 Mar 2026). The empresia page mirrors BORME; the Glow strike-off is at https://find-and-update.company-information.service.gov.uk/company/06752950.
